inferred: landing.parachute_area_m2 is not in the params, so the model solved for the area implied by descent_speed_full_hold_ms 4.6 m/s at twice dry mass: 357.1 m2. Measured descent speeds are therefore anchored to that claim rather than independent of it. The params should state the area.
verification.heat_scale_calibration: Heat is reported on the 0-100 bar. The scale is fixed once so that an empty ship making a single-pass descent from the suborbital band peaks at 100, which is the crew's own normalisation. Every other figure is measured relative to that.

ballistic_coefficient.note: mass / (drag coefficient x reference area). Real reentry capsules run 300-500; below roughly 50 the atmosphere stops the ship rather than braking it, so multi-pass aerobraking cannot exist however the other numbers are tuned.
